name: Adversarial Training (GAN)
definition: Training a discriminator network in parallel with the super-resolution generator to classify images as ground truth or predicted, using the discriminator's output as a loss term for the generator.
summary: Adversarial Training uses a parallel discriminator to classify rendered images as real or fake, adding a game-theoretic loss that encourages photorealism and high-frequency detail to overcome the blurriness of standard pixel-wise reconstruction.
